tools.name: list_business_types
tools.description: Every business type that can be searched, with its id. Free.

tools.name: count_businesses
tools.description: How many businesses of a type near a city list no website, and how many list one, with what the full list would cost. Free.

tools.name: build_list
tools.description: Starts building the full list: every business, with each listed website visited now. Costs 1 credit per business ($3 per 1,000), taken when the build starts; unused credits come back. Returns an id; call get_list with it until status is done.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: The state of a list and, when it is done, every business with what was found. Free.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Visits one website now and reports whether it loads, is broken or looks out of date, with the reason. Costs 1 credit ($0.003).

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: How many credits this key holds. Free.
